select-option-layer.purpose: Coordinate grouped options, unavailable choices, stale data, permission reasons, keyboard movement, and responsive popover-to-sheet behavior for Select-based choice flows.
useWhen: A Select needs grouped, disabled, permissioned, or explanatory options.
Changing a choice affects policy, billing, routing, or visibility.
The option layer needs a responsive fallback beyond a native dropdown.
doNotUseWithoutReview: A simple Select with a short static list is sufficient.
The option layer duplicates a full form or process.
foundations: Defines layer width, option grouping, row density, and mobile sheet fallback.
Owns option labels, group labels, disabled reasons, and helper copy.
Controls selected, highlighted, disabled, and warning states.
Option layer separates from page content without losing field context.
Closed, open, selected, disabled, loading, stale, and invalid states are explicit.
Requires labelled field, keyboard option movement, and disabled reason text.
slots: Label, value, metadata, selected, disabled, and reason.
Responsive layer when native select is insufficient.
variants: Choice set with helper copy and selected state.
Disabled option explains why it is unavailable.
Complex choices move to sheet when viewport is constrained.
motion: Layer opens from the field after user action.
Selection updates field and helper state without layout jump.
Mobile fallback uses system sheet motion and reduced-motion behavior.
accessibility: Keyboard users can move through options.
Mobile fallback has a close path.
tests: Escape or cancel closes without changing value.

canDecide: Use Select Option Layer when a choice needs disabled reasons or grouped context.
Use Bottom Sheet fallback for complex mobile option sets.
mustAsk: Permission rules, stale option policy, or consequences of changing value are unclear.
rejectIf: The option list is a disguised form.
miel.handoff: Confirm option source, grouping, disabled reasons, mobile fallback, and selection consequence.
